```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Set up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
```
Scatterplot
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, col = name)) + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temperature (C)",
    y = "Min Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA for these weather stations."
  )
```

Colar scale
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, col = name)) + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temperature (C)",
    y = "Min Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA for these weather stations."
  ) +
  scatter_x_continous (
    breaks = c(-10, 0, 15),
    labels = c("-10 C", "0", "Fifteen")
  ) + 
  scale_by_continous(
    trans = "sqrt",
    position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, col = name)) + 
  geom_point() + scale_color_hue(h = c(100, 300))
```
